declarations.name: AuiTimeline

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Accessible name of the list (and of the scroll region when horizontal).

inputs.name: items
inputs.description: Items in display order: { id, title, time?, description?, tone?, status?, icon?, avatar?, href?, actions? }.

inputs.name: order
inputs.description: Order of items; older items collapse and load at the older end.

inputs.name: initialVisible
inputs.description: Show this many items and collapse the older rest behind 'Show N older'.

inputs.name: loadMore
inputs.description: Fetch older items; the context has an AbortSignal and the oldest item.

inputs.name: hasMore
inputs.description: More items can be loaded; an empty result sets it to false.

inputs.name: businessCalendar
inputs.description: Names holidays and non-working days in day headings.

inputs.name: empty
inputs.description: Text when there are no items.

inputs.name: icons
inputs.description: Tone markers, 'Show older', and retry icons.

inputs.name: layout
inputs.description: Items on one side, or alternating sides (vertical).

inputs.name: timeFormat
inputs.description: '3 hours ago' or a formatted time; the full date is always in the title and datetime.

inputs.name: groupByDay
inputs.description: Group consecutive items of the same day under a day heading.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Locale for dates, numbers, and messages.

inputs.name: timezone
inputs.description: IANA timezone for grouping and formatting instants.

outputs.name: action
outputs.description: An item action was activated: { itemId, actionId, item }.

outputs.name: toggled
outputs.description: Older items were shown or collapsed: { expanded }.

outputs.name: loadError
outputs.description: loadMore rejected or returned invalid items: { error }.

methods.name: setExpanded
methods.description: Show or collapse older items (no event).

methods.name: loadOlder
methods.description: Run loadMore as the 'Load older' button does.

accessibility.pattern: Structured content: an ordered list of events (day groups as list items with a heading and a nested ordered list); native links and buttons for actions; a horizontal timeline is a focusable, labelled scroll region.

limitations: Not virtualized: keep the rendered items to a few hundred with initialVisible or loadMore.
Relative times are computed at render; call update({ now }) to refresh them.
The alternate layout applies to vertical timelines only.
